purpose: The in-process D baseline was rejected by the playtest request ceiling after six expression calls. This file records a later offline resolution in a fresh process. It did not call a provider.

original_pair_mismatch.player_facing: The controlled playtest request limit has been reached. Stop and export diagnostics; do not restart to continue this session.
original_pair_mismatch.cause: ASHEN_PROVIDER_REQUEST_LIMIT was 6 and six expression requests had already been dispatched in that process. The baseline chat turn was refused before investigation resolution. The live D1 turn itself resolved before that refusal.

offline_baseline.player_facing: You inspect prints. Faint overlapping prints mark the mud around the old milestone, but their number, origin, and direction stay unclear.

comparison_to_live_d1.note: Faction pressure and the event log move during deterministic clue resolution. The same values appear with the provider disabled.
